title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 56 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 56)

content.overview: Section 56 prescribes the documentary evidence required for enforcement of a Geneva Convention foreign award, including the award, arbitration agreement and evidence establishing the award's foreign status under the statutory scheme.
